basic_details.job_title: Begusarai Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon/Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 support staff posts – one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly – in the Evening Court, Begusarai, on a contractual basis. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Begusarai on or before 5 December 2026, either in person or through registered post.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process, and it does not print an amount of pay.

content_sections.heading: About Begusarai Civil Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Begusarai, in Bihar. The posts are support staff for the Evening Court of the Begusarai Judgeship, and the notice was signed by the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Begusarai on 7 November 2026. The notice directs that it be circulated to all judgeships of Bihar and uploaded to the website of the Begusarai Judgeship.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Begusarai. They must reach this office on or before 5 December 2026. The notice allows two ways of submission: By hand, submitted personally at the office By registered post The notice prints no fuller postal address with a PIN code, no application form, no envelope superscription and no list of documents to enclose. Because the deadline is for receipt, an application sent by registered post must arrive at the office by 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Eligibility rests on being a retired Civil Court employee together with the post-specific experience shown in the table above. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post. The notice prints no amount of remuneration. It states that the period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Begusarai Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies in the Evening Court, Begusarai: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Begusarai Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Begusarai on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Begusarai Evening Court support staff posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. They must also be physically and mentally fit and have satisfactory service records with no major disciplinary punishment.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Begusarai Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Begusarai, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches the office on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Begusarai Evening Court job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna, and gives no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q7. What are the working hours in the Evening Court, Begusarai?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 5 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q8. How will the remuneration be decided?
faq.answer: The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions will be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.
